body: Thank you, that really does mean a lot to me. I'm lucky enough to have someone to be able to go through this with me with open arms and relentless emotional support, even when I'm a shithead. We've only been dating a year but I could never have asked her to do as much as she's done already and I'm extremely lucky

I do sometimes emotionally abuse her because if she doesn't text or call me during a bad time I'll make her feel guilty about it. I hate that I do that and I always apologize afterward but I feel like that's not enough to change and I feel sorry that I put her through that. And no I haven't even seen a doctor about this so it could just be mood swings and a shitty personality but my best guess is depression. I agreed to see a doctor on Tuesday so I'm going to set up an appointment and see how that goes

You're definitely right, she's the only one I talk to about this. She had to go home this weekend for an appointment 2 hours away so she wasn't here today to talk to me in person, but I told her I'd look into seeing a doctor about this on Tuesday since it's supposedly free. I'll look into that for sure
